items.title: Fraud Detection in Python
items.description: Classifies 594K+ synthetic BankSim payments as fraudulent or legitimate, comparing Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, a Neural Network, Decision Tree and Random Forest on precision, recall and false positives.

items.title: Text Analysis with NLP
items.description: Interactive Streamlit app for text preprocessing, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging and word clouds.

items.title: StreamLedger
items.description: Event-sourced, CQRS ledger for balances and inventory. Optimistic concurrency stops double-spends, and dedupe keys make retried commands safe. 48+ tests run fully in memory.

items.title: agentgate
items.description: Gateway between LLM agents and internal APIs, with per-agent policy rules, Redis-backed rate limits and cost budgets, and a Postgres audit log with replay.

items.title: sentinel-triage
items.description: Correlates auth and endpoint logs into incidents, matches Sigma rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and measures precision, recall and false-positive rate on a labeled dataset.

items.title: AI-SOC
items.description: Local research SOC with Wazuh-format ingestion, flow classification, local Ollama triage with retrieved security knowledge, incident correlation, analyst review, Sigma rule export and role-based accounts.

items.title: InfoHunter
items.description: Python OSINT toolkit for usernames, email addresses and domains, with a CLI, a local Streamlit dashboard and PDF reports. Built for authorized investigations only.

items.title: Conversa — Real-Time Chat
items.description: Full-stack MERN chat app with Socket.IO messaging, a Google Gemini AI chatbot, image sharing via AWS S3, email verification and a responsive dark/light UI.

items.title: CIS Compliance Config Rule
items.description: Custom AWS Config rule backed by Lambda that runs Chef InSpec CIS benchmark audits through Systems Manager, so instance OS compliance is monitored continuously.

items.title: Asset Management & Compliance Dashboard
items.description: Centralized dashboard for security assessment, CIS benchmark compliance checks and data loss prevention across Ubuntu and Windows machines provisioned with Vagrant.
